t: A Bulgar state founded by Turkic-speaking migrants at the confluence of the Volga and Kama rivers.
In 922 its ruler adopted Islam, making it the first state of eastern Europe with Islam as its official faith.
It grew rich on northern furs and Islamic silver until the Mongols destroyed it in 1236.
dyk: Chuvash, spoken today in the Volga region of Russia, is the only living language of the Oghuric branch of Turkic, the branch spoken by the Volga Bulgars.
ev: Bulgar groups move north from the Black Sea steppe to the middle Volga
Ruler Almish adopts Islam during the embassy described by Ibn Fadlan
Sviatoslav I of Kiev breaks Khazar power, ending Bulgar tribute
Vladimir of Kiev campaigns against the Bulgars and makes peace
Andrei Bogolyubsky of Vladimir-Suzdal takes the Bulgar town of Bryakhimov
The Bulgars defeat a Mongol force near the Samara Bend
The Mongols destroy Bilyar and conquer Volga Bulgaria

f.founder: Bulgar tribes from Old Great Bulgaria
